display.purpose: Booth screen titles; setup h1 scales fluidly with clamp(2rem, 8vw, 3rem).

body.purpose: Running text and inputs; subtitles cap at 36ch in Warm Muted.

label.purpose: Button labels; the most-used size in the booth CSS.

guest-body.purpose: Guest page status and save note. System UI stack because the inline-only CSP forbids font files.

guest-button.purpose: The single Save to Photos label on the guest page.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Booth input focus, with the border at rgba(196,92,74,.55).

shadows.name: hanging-print
shadows.purpose: Guest strip, as a filter; paper hanging in light.

shadows.name: floating-save
shadows.purpose: Guest Save button, glow tinted with wordmark red.

shadows.name: printer-body
shadows.purpose: Guest printer band hanging over the page.

shadows.name: slot-recess
shadows.purpose: Guest printer slot; the one native near-black, because it is a hole.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Guest Save background and 1px press; studio buttons use .15s ease with scale(.97).

motion.name: guest-feed
motion.purpose: Each of three stepped paper feeds (300ms feed, 90ms hold); never linear tweens.

motion.name: guest-zoom
motion.purpose: Strip zoom to full height and the Save button's 16px rise (380ms, delay 1750ms).

motion.name: guest-lift
motion.purpose: Printer lifts away on ease-in, delay 1380ms.

motion.name: guest-develop
motion.purpose: Warm haze (#cdc6bc) clears bottom-up across the photos, delay 200ms.

motion.name: guest-sequence
motion.purpose: Whole print from image load; once per strip per phone; reduced motion and repeat visits open finished.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Booth primary action: terracotta fill, white semibold label, 52px tall.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 52px; min-width: 148px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; background: #c45c4a; color: #fff; font-family: Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), background 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2d2926; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Booth secondary action: ink-alpha fill with hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 52px; min-width: 148px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(45, 38, 32, 0.12); border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(45, 38, 32, 0.06); color: #2d2926; font-family: Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), background 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(45, 38, 32, 0.1); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2d2926; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Raised-paper field with terracotta focus border and halo.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; max-width: 660px; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(45, 38, 32, 0.12); border-radius: 10px; background: #faf6f0; color: #2d2926; font-family: Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; transition: border-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b635b; opacity: 0.6; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: rgba(196, 92, 74, 0.55); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(196, 92, 74, 0.14); }

components.name: Event Card
components.description: Raised paper card with hairline border on the paper ground.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 180px; padding: 20px 24px 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(45, 38, 32, 0.12); border-radius: 16px; background: #faf6f0; color: #2d2926; font-family: Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { margin: auto 0 0; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-card-meta { margin: 4px 0 0; color: #6b635b; font-size: 0.875rem; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Setup page connection status; ink-alpha pill, green when on.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-block; padding: 5px 11px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(45, 38, 32, 0.07); color: #6b635b; font-family: Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-pill-on { background: #e3f3e6; color: #28703f; }

components.name: Guest Save Button
components.description: The single floating action on the guest strip page; system UI type by CSP.
components.html: Save to Photos
components.css: .ds-guest-save { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-width: 232px; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 26px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: #c45c4a; color: #fff; font: 700 19px/1 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.22), 0 2px 4px rgba(45,41,38,.16), 0 14px 26px -10px rgba(143,32,28,.5); transition: background-color .15s ease-out, transform .15s ease-out; } .ds-guest-save svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex: none; } .ds-guest-save:hover { background: #b9513f; } .ds-guest-save:active { background: #a8473a; transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-guest-save:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2d2926; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Guest Printer
components.description: Guest page only: matte warm-white printer end with recessed lip and slot (emboss filter omitted here; it needs the inline SVG defs).
components.css: .ds-printer { position: relative; width: 320px; height: 142px; border-radius: 0 0 22px 22px; overflow: hidden; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fdfbf7 0%, #f9f5ef 55%, #f3eee6 100%); box-shadow: 0 2px 3px rgba(60,44,34,.16), 0 20px 30px -14px rgba(60,44,34,.45); } .ds-printer-mark { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 24px; text-align: center; color: #faf7f2; font: 600 34px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; text-shadow: 0 -1px 0 #fff, 0 1.6px 2px rgba(60,44,34,.22); } .ds-lip { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 46px; background: linear-gradient(#e6dfd5 0, #ede7de 40%, #e9e2d8 82%, #d6cdc0 89%, #c9bfb1 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(80,62,48,.18), inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7); } .ds-slot { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 12px; width: 172px; height: 9px; margin-left: -86px; border-radius: 2px; background: linear-gradient(#030202 0%, #120f0d 55%, #2b2420 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 3px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.85), 0 -1px 0 rgba(80,62,48,.3); } .ds-slot::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -3px; right: -3px; top: 100%; height: 3px; border-radius: 0 0 2px 2px; background: linear-gradient(#fffdf9, #efe8de); box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(80,62,48,.18); }

components.name: Guest Print
components.description: The strip on pure white paper, hanging with a warm drop shadow; the brightest object on screen.
components.css: .ds-print { width: 96px; aspect-ratio: 1 / 3; filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 1px rgba(45,41,38,.16)) drop-shadow(0 14px 20px rgba(45,41,38,.2)); } .ds-print-paper { height: 100%; background: #fff linear-gradient(to bottom, #cdc6bc 0 42%, rgba(205,198,188,.55) 50%, rgba(205,198,188,0) 58%) no-repeat 0 0 / 100% 60%; }

narrative.overview:
piccie is a physical object first: a round, matte, warm-white booth with a soft light ring, and every screen inherits that object's materials. Grounds are warm paper, ink is a dark warm brown rather than black, the single action colour is terracotta, and the photo strip is the one pure-white thing on screen. Surfaces are matte and lightly grained, never glossy; depth comes from soft, warm-tinted shadows and, on the guest page, from modelled machine parts (an embossed wordmark, a recessed slot, a lip).

Density is calm and touch-first. The booth kiosk runs on a 7" 1024×600 panel with a 19px root, 52px controls and generous page padding; the phone setup page and template studio use the same palette and Outfit face at phone scale; the guest strip page is a single full-screen print with one floating action. Type is Outfit throughout, with tight negative tracking on headings, except on the guest page, where the strict inline-only CSP forbids any font file and the system UI stack stands in.

The guest page is the surface where the world is most literal: the end of a piccie printer hangs across the top of the screen and the strip develops out of its slot. Its parts (printer body, emboss, slot, lip, develop haze) are surface components, documented below, not global decoration for other screens.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper grounds, dark warm ink, one terracotta action colour.
The photo strip sits on pure white and is the brightest object on screen.
Matte, lightly grained surfaces; shadows always tinted warm brown.
Outfit at semibold with negative tracking; system UI only where CSP forbids fonts.
Lowercase "piccie" wordmark in deep wordmark red, used as an identity mark, never as a UI fill.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Terracotta is the only saturated colour on a screen, and it marks the action. A screen has one filled terracotta action; everything else is ink or paper.

rules.name: The Warm Ink Rule
rules.body: No neutral greys and no black shadows. Text, borders and shadows are all warm brown (45,38,32-family) at varying alpha. The guest printer's slot is the one native exception: it is a hole, and it goes near-black (#030202 to #2b2424).

rules.name: The Brightest Object Rule
rules.body: The photo strip is printed on pure white (#ffffff) and is the brightest object on screen. Grounds stay paper; never place the strip on a white page.

rules.name: The Tight Tracking Rule
rules.body: Outfit is always tracked negative: -0.01em for body and labels, -0.02em for titles and headlines, -0.03em to -0.04em for display.

rules.name: The Inline-Only Rule
rules.body: The guest page's CSP is default-src 'none' with inline style only, so it loads no font file and uses the system UI stack. This is a hard constraint of the delivery format, not a lapse; every other surface uses self-hosted Outfit and never a font CDN (a CDN link stalled first paint at no-signal venues).

rules.name: The Matte Grain Rule
rules.body: Matte surfaces carry fractal-noise grain (feTurbulence baseFrequency .85): the booth overlays it at 14% opacity across the kiosk, and the guest printer body multiplies it at 45%. Grain is texture on a material, never a pattern.

dos: Do use Booth Paper (#f2ebe3) as the ground and Raised Paper (#faf6f0) one step up; reserve pure white for the photo strip and text on terracotta.
Do give each screen one filled Terracotta action and keep everything else ink or paper.
Do tint every shadow and border with warm ink (rgba(45,38,32,…)), never neutral black.
Do self-host Outfit and track it negative (-0.01em body, -0.02em titles, -0.03em display).
Do keep touch targets at 52px or taller on the booth and 56px for the guest Save button.
Do open any motion-led surface on its finished state for reduced motion and repeat visits, and never let an animation strand the photo or the save action.
donts: Don't load fonts, scripts or any external file on the guest page; its CSP allows inline style and script and https: images only.
Don't use Wordmark Red (#8f201c) as a button, link or text colour; it belongs to the wordmark.
Don't set the wordmark in anything but lowercase "piccie".
Don't use neutral greys or pure black for text or shadows; the only near-black is the printer slot, because it is a hole.
Don't place the strip on a white page; it must be the brightest object on screen.
